@startuml
title View 1 - Components involved in User Registration (component/interaction view)
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
left to right direction

actor "Integration tester" as T

package "Entry points (boundary)" {
  component "Swing Registration form\n(boundary.Swing.Registration)" as SW
  component "Swing Login\n(boundary.Swing.Login)" as LOGIN
  component "Web page registration.html\n+ app.js api()" as WEB
  component "AuthenticationController\nPOST /api/auth/register\n(boundary.SpringBoot)" as AC
  component "RestExceptionHandler\nIllegalArgument -> 400\nSecurityException -> 401" as REH
}

package "Controller" {
  component "LibraryFacade (singleton)\nregister(...)" as LF
  component "UserManager (singleton)\nvalidate + uniqueness + create" as UM
  interface "UserFactory" as UF
  component "StudentFactory" as SF
  component "LibrarianFactory" as LFAC
}

package "Entity" {
  component "UserRegistry (singleton)\nregisterUser / findUserByEmail /\nfindStudentByStudentNumber /\nfindLibrarianByCode" as UR
  component "User (abstract) <|- Student, Librarian" as ENT
  component "UserDTO" as DTO
}

package "Persistence" {
  component "PersistenceManager\nsave / findFirstByFields" as PM
  component "JpaUtil\nEntityManagerFactory 'reservationsPU'" as JPA
}
database "MySQL reservationsdb\n(tests: reservationsdb_test)\ntable User/Student/Librarian" as DB

package "Spring Boot runtime" {
  component "ReservationsApplication / Launcher" as APP
}

T --> SW : fills form (UI test)
T --> WEB : fills form (UI test)
T --> AC : HTTP form-params\n(API test)
T --> LF : direct call\n(RegistrationTest, TC1-TC20)

SW --> LF : register(role,name,surname,\nemail,password,identifier)
SW ..> LOGIN : on success / "sign in" link
WEB --> AC : fetch POST /api/auth/register\n(x-www-form-urlencoded)
AC --> LF
AC ..> REH : exceptions
LF --> UM
UM --> UF
SF ..|> UF
LFAC ..|> UF
UF ..> ENT : creates
UM --> UR : uniqueness checks,\nregisterUser
UM ..> DTO : toDTO
UR --> PM
PM --> JPA
JPA --> DB : Hibernate / JDBC (root@localhost:3306)
APP ..> AC : hosts REST + static/*.html
APP ..> LOGIN : Launcher opens Swing Login
@enduml
EOF
cat > view-2.puml <<'EOF'
@startuml
title View 2 - Registration interaction sequence (success and failure paths)
actor Tester
participant "Registration form (Swing)\nor registration.html" as UI
participant "AuthenticationController\n(REST path only)" as AC
participant RestExceptionHandler as REH
participant LibraryFacade as LF
participant UserManager as UM
participant UserRegistry as UR
participant "StudentFactory /\nLibrarianFactory" as F
participant PersistenceManager as PM
database MySQL as DB

Tester -> UI : role, name, surname, email,\npassword, identifier
UI -> UI : all fields non-blank?\n(else "Complete all fields" - Swing only)
alt Swing
  UI -> LF : register(role,name,surname,email,password,identifier)
else Web
  UI -> AC : POST /api/auth/register (form params)
  AC -> LF : register(...)
end
LF -> UM : register(...)
UM -> UM : validate(role,name,password)\nrole Student|Librarian; name non-empty;\npassword 8..32 chars
alt role = Student
  UM -> UM : validateStudent: name/surname \\p{L}{1,20};\nemail <255 and ^...@...unina.it$;\nid [A-Za-z0-9]+ and [A-Z]\\d{8}
else role = Librarian
  UM -> UM : validateLibrarian: same name/email rules;\nid [A-Za-z0-9]+
end
UM -> UR : institutionalEmailExists(email)
UR -> PM : findFirstByFields(User, institutionalEmail)
PM -> DB : SELECT
DB --> PM
UM -> UR : findStudentByStudentNumber(id) /\nfindLibrarianByCode(id)
UR -> PM : findFirstByFields(...)
PM -> DB : SELECT
alt duplicate email / identifier
  UM --> LF : IllegalArgumentException\n("Email is already associated..." /\n"Identifier is already in use.")
else new user
  UM -> F : createUser(name,surname,email,password,id)
  F --> UM : Student / Librarian
  UM -> UR : registerUser(user)
  UR -> PM : save(user)
  PM -> DB : INSERT (transaction, rollback on error)
  PM --> UR : true / false
  alt save false
    UM --> LF : RuntimeException("Server error: ...")
  else saved
    UM --> LF : UserDTO (role, id, name, surname,\nemail, identifier)
  end
end
LF --> UI : UserDTO or exception
alt exception, REST path
  AC ..> REH : IllegalArgumentException -> HTTP 400 {"error":msg}
  REH --> UI : error message shown (#error div)
  note right: A RuntimeException (save failure) is not mapped\nin RestExceptionHandler.
else exception, Swing
  UI -> Tester : "Registration error" dialog
else success
  UI -> Tester : "Registration complete! You can now sign in."\n-> redirect to Login / index.html
end
@enduml
EOF
cat > view-3.puml <<'EOF'
@startuml
title View 3 - Data model and test-relevant constraints for registration
abstract class User {
  id : Long <<generated, IDENTITY>>
  name
  surname
  institutionalEmail <<not null, unique>>
  password
  failedAttempts : int
  lockedUntil : LocalDateTime
}
class Student {
  studentNumber <<not null, unique>>
  totalVisitCount : int
}
class Librarian {
  internalIdentifierCode <<not null, unique>>
}
class Reservation
class UserDTO {
  id, name, surname
  institutionalEmail
  role, identifier
  totalVisitCount
}
interface UserFactory {
  createUser(name,surname,email,password,identifier) : User
}
class StudentFactory
class LibrarianFactory
class UserManager <<singleton>>
class UserRegistry <<singleton>>
class PersistenceManager

User <|-- Student : JOINED inheritance
User <|-- Librarian
Student "1" o-- "*" Reservation
UserFactory <|.. StudentFactory
UserFactory <|.. LibrarianFactory
StudentFactory ..> Student : creates
LibrarianFactory ..> Librarian : creates
UserManager ..> UserFactory
UserManager --> UserRegistry
UserManager ..> UserDTO : returns
UserRegistry --> PersistenceManager
PersistenceManager ..> User : persist / query

note bottom of UserManager
  Rules checked before persisting (UserManager):
  role in {Student, Librarian}; password 8-32;
  names letters only, 1-20; email < 255, *@*unina.it;
  Student id = [A-Z]\d{8}; Librarian id alphanumeric;
  duplicate email / identifier rejected.
  DB unique constraints are a second line of defence.
end note
@enduml
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Registration (UC1) - architecture views for the integration tester

All elements come from `JavaProject/src` (main and test). Plain-text note: the project is a Java/Spring Boot + Swing app with a MySQL database via JPA/Hibernate.

- **view-1.puml - Component view.** Shows every component that takes part in registration, grouped by layer (boundary, controller, entity, persistence, MySQL), and the four places a test can drive it: the Swing form, `registration.html`, the REST endpoint `POST /api/auth/register`, or `LibraryFacade.register` directly (what `RegistrationTest` does). Use it to choose test entry points and see which components are real in each integration level (DB must be running; test persistence unit uses `reservationsdb_test`).
- **view-2.puml - Sequence view.** Shows the step-by-step interaction for a registration: UI checks, facade, `UserManager` validation, duplicate lookups through `UserRegistry`/`PersistenceManager`, factory creation, INSERT, and how each failure (validation, duplicate, save failure) surfaces in the Swing dialog or as HTTP 400. Use it to derive test cases and expected outcomes at each interaction. It also notes a gap: a save-failure `RuntimeException` is not mapped by `RestExceptionHandler`.
- **view-3.puml - Data/constraint view.** Shows the entities, DTO and factories involved, DB unique constraints, and the validation rules enforced by `UserManager`. Use it for test data design (valid/invalid boundaries, duplicate email/identifier) and for cleanup (`RegistrationTest` deletes from `Reservation` and `User`).
EOF

I wrote three PlantUML views and a README to `./task2view-out/IS-reg-L1/`. All three views pass `plantuml -checkonly`. I didn't run the application or the tests.

- **`view-1.puml`, components:** every component involved in registration, grouped by layer, plus the four ways a test can drive it.
  - The Swing registration form.
  - The web page `registration.html`.
  - `POST /api/auth/register`.
  - Calling `LibraryFacade.register` directly, as `RegistrationTest` does.
  - The layers behind them are the controllers, entities, persistence code and the MySQL database.
- **`view-2.puml`, sequence:** the step-by-step registration flow.
  - It covers UI checks, `LibraryFacade`, `UserManager` validation, the duplicate lookups, the factory, and the database insert.
  - It also shows how each failure surfaces: a Swing error dialog or an HTTP 400.
- **`view-3.puml`, data and rules:** the `User`, `Student` and `Librarian` entities, the DTO and the factories. It also lists the database unique constraints and the validation rules `UserManager` enforces, which is what you need for test data and cleanup.

One gap I found while tracing the code: if saving the user fails, `UserManager` throws a `RuntimeException`. `RestExceptionHandler` doesn't map it, so the REST path won't return the clean `{"error": ...}` body it does for validation errors.

The README explains each view and why it's there.
